phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Capacitive soil moisture sensor probe system integrating a capacitive sensing probe with a microcontroller unit (MCU) and short-range wireless communication radio module, typically used for remote soil moisture monitoring in precision agriculture.

phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Capacitive soil moisture sensor probe integrated with a microcontroller unit (MCU) and wireless communication radio module for precise soil moisture measurement and real-time data transmission in agricultural applications.
